sections.content: A 2026 process-architecture initiative for regulatory operations, combining workflow/state design, SLAs, role clarity, Google Workspace automation and proposed LLM assistance.
sections.title: Summary

sections.content: The existing regulatory workflow relied on manual capture, ambiguous status definitions and limited visibility. The goal was to define a more traceable operating model that could support faster handling, explicit escalation and later automation.
sections.title: Business problem

sections.content:
Evidence supports technical leadership in:

- mapping the As-Is process and designing the To-Be workflow
- defining ticket states and transitions
- parameterizing SLAs and escalation logic
- documenting roles and responsibilities through RACI
- producing flow diagrams and executive infographics
- proposing Gemini/LLM assistance for summarizing regulatory changes and pre-assessing possible impact
- connecting Google Sheets, Forms, Apps Script, workflow tooling and reporting concepts
sections.title: Contribution and ownership

sections.content: The design was approved for phased implementation. Time reductions were projected targets, not fully validated production outcomes at the source cutoff.

sections.title: Approved public narrative

sections.content:
